command:
set +e
# spawn runs task commands under bash -e; `set -uo pipefail` does not clear it (spawn#707).
set -uo pipefail
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp
mkdir -p /tmp/out && cd /tmp/out
# The TCGA PanCanAtlas (Hoadley et al. 2018) RNA-seq matrix and its sample annotations, fetched on AWS
# from the GDC by file UUID and checked against the md5 in each file's GDC record before they are kept.
fetch() {
  if command -v curl >/dev/null; then curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o "$2" "https://api.gdc.cancer.gov/data/$1"
  else Rscript -e "options(timeout=3600); download.file(\"https://api.gdc.cancer.gov/data/$1\", \"$2\", mode=\"wb\", quiet=TRUE)"; fi || { echo "FAIL: fetch $2"; exit 1; }
  got=$(md5sum "$2" | cut -d' ' -f1)
  [ "$got" = "$3" ] || { echo "FAIL: $2 md5 $got, GDC record says $3"; exit 1; }
  echo "$2 md5 $got == GDC"
}
fetch 3586c0da-64d0-4b74-a449-5ff4d9136611 EBPlusPlusAdjustPANCAN_IlluminaHiSeq_RNASeqV2.geneExp.tsv 02e72c33071307ff6570621480d3c90b
fetch 1a7d7be8-675d-4e60-a105-19d4121bdebf merged_sample_quality_annotations.tsv 05ddd2270fb1fb24fbdc2fe9bf7384e5
sha256sum EBPlusPlusAdjustPANCAN_IlluminaHiSeq_RNASeqV2.geneExp.tsv merged_sample_quality_annotations.tsv | tee data.sha256
ls -l
echo DONE
